issues.title: Gen I Add/Create destination in packed boxes: refused destinations, then appended at packed position not cursor cell (needs product decision)

owner_words.text: - **Gen I R/B/Y:** Create flow is now reachable from arbitrary empty visual cells, but `Stage Add` still serializes the new Pokémon at the native packed append position next to existing Pokémon, not at the exact empty visual cell the cursor was on. This needs an explicit product decision because native Gen I boxes are packed/contiguous and do not persist arbitrary sparse holes. Do not silently pretend native slot 14 exists if only two Pokémon are stored.

- Gen I R/B/Y Add/Create currently refuses destinations because of a global `next writable slot` / contiguous-box rule; the selected current box should be writable when native capacity exists, while still respecting the packed Gen I format and not fabricating persistent sparse holes.

issues.title: Create requires the native required fields before Keep/Add: explicit Met Location choice (Gen III-V, exact-game list, never "value != 0") and at least one move (app policy) — owner asked for it "for all gens"

owner_words.text: **Create validation is exact-game / format-aware.** "At least one move" is an **app policy** for a usable Pokémon, not a legality proof, and is labelled as such. Met Location is required as an **explicit choice** in the exact game's own location list. Never require a *nonzero* value: a real native Pokémon can legitimately carry location 0 or no recorded location (for example Gen III RSE index 0, Gen IV/V special or "----" entries, traded or event records). The check must use each game's native semantics, never one universal rule.

issues.title: H25: species change carried previous Pokemon's Met Location and Pokerus (stale editor state); Create drafts reset visibly, existing Pokemon keep history and get a Caution flag (never silently deleted)

owner_words.text: H25 is genuine preserved Pokémon history. Species editing must not silently clear Pokérus, origin or Met Location. Flag suspect combinations in Editor/Review.

**H25 history vs stale editor state.** On an existing Pokémon, recorded history (Met Location, Met Level, Pokérus, ball, egg/fateful data) is **preserved**. When it is incompatible with a newly chosen species, it is **flagged** in the editor and in Review, never silently deleted. New drafts reset properly and never inherit another record's state; the editor panels always re-read the record being edited, so nothing stale is shown.

issues.title: Species change Level: whether a species change keeps the Pokemon's current Level has NO SPECIFICATION; generations behave differently today

occurrences.src: n/a (searched docs/ and root status files)

issues.status_basis: No spec (F0106 "NO SPECIFICATION FOUND"). Current code per gen: Gen I — Create AND Edit reset Level to SpeciesChangeLevelPolicy::defaultLevel (exact-game minimum encounter level, fallback 5) and drop EXP (src/UI/Gen1PokemonEditorOverlayUXCleanup3.inc:198-201 AddDraft, :222-224 Edit). Gen II — Create AND Edit reset Level/EXP to defaultLevel (include/UI/Gen2PokemonSession.h:75-86). Gen III — Create AND Edit reset Level/EXP to defaultLevel (include/UI/Gen3SharedPokemonSession.h:162; test tests/test_gen3_shared_pokemon_session.cpp:194-211 asserts an Edit at Level 80 becomes the encounter minimum and "!= 80"). Gen IV — keeps the current Level, rewriting EXP for the new growth rate (src/Pokemon/Pokemon4Mutable.cpp:426,452-454). Gen V — Edit refuses a species with a different EXP growth group ("its level would change", include/Integration/Gen5/Gen5SharedScreenState.h:603-607), so Level is kept; Create rebuild keeps the draft Level (:665-667). Policy origin: include/UI/SpeciesChangeLevelPolicy.h ("never inherited from the previous species"), commit 63ce8877 (2026-09-20). Unknown: the owner's intended rule; Gen I-III Edit behaviour silently changes an existing Pokemon's Level/EXP, inconsistent with Gen IV/V and with the H25 "history kept" spirit.
